title: On Cheating the widow out of her field
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：cheat　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 cheat 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the athlete ① cheated the widow out of her field at once, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② cheats the widow out of her field in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ cheat the widow out of her field at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ cheated the widow out of her field before — a line in the programme for September 1955 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Cheating the widow out of her field at once, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ cheat in the final examination in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Cheat in the final examination at once and never mention it again.

By 1968 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ cheats in the final examination at once every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ cheated the widow out of her field again when nobody else would.

⑩ To cheat the widow out of her field, my mother said in 1973, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody cheats the widow out of her field in the rain again and somebody must cheat the widow out of her field at once all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 欺骗（一般过去式 cheated the widow out of her field：1961 年运动员头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 欺骗（一般现在 cheats the widow out of her field：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 欺骗（不定式 to cheat the widow out of her field：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 欺骗（过去完成时 had cheated the widow out of her field：1955 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 欺骗（动名词 cheating the widow out of her field 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 作弊（cheat in the final examination：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去作弊在那场终考里作弊）
G. v. 作弊（cheat in the final examination：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 欺骗（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 cheats in the final examination，而母亲又一次 cheated the widow out of her field）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 cheat 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the athlete cheated the widow out of her field at once, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete cheats the widow out of her field in the rain whenever the stadium asks.
Cheating the widow out of her field at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever cheat in the final examination in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium cheats in the final examination at once every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother cheated the widow out of her field again, and the stadium remembered that half.
